source_review.notes: Reviewed current official OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, Linux perf, HPCToolkit, Score-P/OTF2, Caliper, Nsight Systems, VTune and MPI 5.0 documentation plus primary instrumentation research. Clock, sampling, tool-scope, portability and overhead limits are retained.

evidence: Work, span, processor count, elapsed time, utilization, clock mappings, loss and observer effect have distinct definitions.
Inclusive/exclusive, wall/CPU/runnable/blocked/device and temporal/causal distinctions are explicit.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Checked units, denominators and dependency terminology.

evidence: Recomputed work 4+3+5+2=14 and critical path A,C,D=11.
Recomputed average parallelism 14/11=1.272727 and P=2 lower bound max(11,ceil(14/2))=11.
Recomputed Exercise 1 span 14 and snippet passed exact stdout.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Values apply only to the stated additive DAG model.

evidence: Verified T >= max(S,W/P) under the declared equivalent-processor work/span model.
Checked that adding precedence B->C preserves work while increasing span.
Checked critical paths require semantic DAG edges and overlap unions must avoid pairwise double counting.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No trace proximity is used to infer causality.

evidence: Reviewed clock step/drift/uncertainty, ID reuse/forgery, buffer loss, throttling, multiplexing, stack failure and unsupported events.
Reviewed startup/warm-up/phase bias, debug/binary mismatch, task migration, spinning, barrier symptom, GPU asynchrony and hybrid ownership.
Reviewed observer effect, omitted work, sensitive baggage, trace volume, emergency dispatch and air-traffic transfer.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Covers collection, semantic, statistical, operational, security and high-stakes boundaries.

evidence: Run identity and workload/topology/configuration remain immutable and comparison-equivalent.
Clock/correlation, symbols/stacks, sampling/multiplexing and loss health are validated before interpretation.
Causal graph, mutually exclusive states, non-double-counted metrics, correctness outputs and raw evidence are preserved.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked the measurement chain from collection through intervention.

evidence: Experimental equivalence, collection integrity, causal analysis, intervention and claim-boundary obligations are separate.
Critical-path conclusions derive from semantics and stable identities rather than visualization proximity.
Before/after credit requires both end-metric change and predicted causal-signal change with correctness retained.
proof_review.notes: Observed profiles and traces are not represented as universal causal or scaling proofs.

evidence: The executable DAG model disclaims collection, clock correction, contention and program equivalence.
Sampling estimates, trace observations, analytic bounds and worst-case claims are distinguished.
Emergency-dispatch and air-traffic cases name reviewers and claim none.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Certification, deadline and operational capacity claims remain external.

evidence: Python work/span model reproduced exact output and zero exit status.
Required run evidence includes exact binary/input/topology, tools/configuration, health/loss, raw values, repetitions and uncertainty.
Known-positive probes and before/profiled comparisons test collection visibility and perturbation.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No real profiler, cluster, GPU, dispatch or aviation result is claimed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed question-driven collection, metric semantics, work/span DAGs, clocks/identity, health, imbalance, CPU/MPI/GPU layers, overlap, experiments, secure operations and high-stakes limits.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed immutable run identity, counter availability/scaling, symbol/unwind probes, rank/device artifact identity, clock calibration, context propagation, loss/backpressure, overhead baselines, phase windows, interleaved repetitions, correctness gates and raw-query retention.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter advances from a compact work/span example through multi-clock hybrid diagnosis, counters eighteen misconceptions, provides ten examples through emergency dispatch, and includes five fully answered exercises ending in air-traffic transfer.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner and pedagogical evidence only; no external OpenTelemetry/W3C/Linux/HPCToolkit/Score-P/Caliper/NVIDIA/Intel/MPI, performance-tool, statistics, cluster/device/network, emergency-operations, aviation/air-traffic, real-time/safety, security/privacy, operations, quality/regulatory/certification, ethics, accessibility/human-factors or independent validation review is claimed. The chapter and example prove neither profiler correctness, trace completeness, exact causality, application correctness, performance portability, scalable capacity, worst-case timing, certification nor operational safety.
